Thanks for the quick intro last week. We're preparing our SOC 2 intake and DPA review and would like a short intake call to confirm scope before we send the preflight questionnaire to our security team. Ideally something compact — 30 or 45 minutes max — to cover:
- high-level architecture and data flows
- retention and deletion controls
- pen-test / third-party vendor expectations

Can your team run a short "sprint" style intake next week? Our initial availability is:
- Tue 2/29: 09:00–11:00 PT
- Wed 3/1: 13:00–15:30 PT

- Ben (copied) will cover pen-test and network/VPC questions. Marissa will cover SOC 2 evidence mapping.

1) Tue 2/29 09:30–10:00 (30 min) — compact intake
2) Wed 3/1 13:30–14:15 (45 min) — more room for DPA discussion
3) Wed 3/1 14:30–15:00 (30 min) — fallback

Please let us know preferred slot and timezone for calendar invite. I'll attach a lightweight preflight checklist on our side that mirrors the fields in your questionnaire to make the call efficient.
